name: apply_patch
description: Create, update, delete, or move UTF-8 text files with one patch; prefer it over multiple edit calls when a change spans several files or separated regions.

input.description: Patch text: start with *** Begin Patch and end with *** End Patch. Use *** Add File: path with + lines; *** Update File: path, optionally followed by *** Move to: path, with @@ or @@ context and space-prefixed context, + added, or - removed lines; *** End of File anchors the last hunk to the file end. Use *** Delete File: path to delete. Paths are relative to the Session working directory.

prompt: Prefer apply_patch over separate edit calls for changes across files or separated regions. Give every hunk enough surrounding context lines to match one place in the current file. The whole patch is checked first (syntax, hunk matching, missing files) and a rejected patch changes nothing; once applying starts, operations run in order, stop at the first failure, and are not rolled back, so re-read affected files before retrying when needed.
